question: The roads connecting the state capital to various district headquarters are known as ______. These roads are constructed and maintained by the State Public Works Department (PWD) in the states and union territories.
solution:
The correct answer is __**State Highway.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **State Highway:**

 
 
• **State Highways are the roads that connect the state capital to various district headquarters.** They are considered to be an important part of the transportation infrastructure of a state or a union territory.
 
• **These are constructed and maintained by the State Public Works Department (PWD) in the respective states and union territories.**
 
 
• This department is responsible for the development and maintenance of roads, bridges, and other infrastructure projects in the state.
